integrity: The infinite theorem is proved from the published identification of algebraic closure with I-closure, the published type-by-marked-closure criterion, and direct finite bipartite counting. Exhaustive computation is used only to replay small cases and threshold exclusions.
scientific_limitations: The exact type-count formulas are proved only for arities r<min(m,n). No classification is claimed for the intermediate arities where algebraic closure can grow, and no resolution is claimed for the first infinite-type arity. A047863 and the random-bipartite enumeration are prior art; novelty is restricted to the generic-incidence stabilization and prefix-versus-continuum consequence.
title: Arbitrarily long random-bipartite type prefixes in generic incidence theories
